item.title: Monday 4 PM Update, Nov 9
item.description:
The Monday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 9, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Representative Massie formally files Hegseth impeachment articles on the House floor as Speaker Johnson pushes back; the FDA orders a rare vision-loss warning on all GLP-1 drugs; a possible Trump, Xi and Putin meeting in China; the Turkey steel-plant toll climbs to 17; Germany's Merz ties the EU budget to more Ukraine aid; stocks close with their best day in months while Nvidia slides; Chinese robots open Web Summit in Lisbon; Anthropic and Meta ship new A I models; France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for the supermarket fridge hack as U.S. agencies warn about refrigeration controllers; your X feed; a White Mountains wildfire update and a Concord Monitor investigation; and a cat rescued from a landfill couch. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Nov 9
item.description:
The Monday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 9, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Representative Massie files to force a House vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth, who plans a rare press conference; Trump meets Qatar's prime minister on Iran as oil falls; two arrests and a brief lockdown near the White House; Europeans press Secretary Rubio at the G7 in Paris; who's coming to the Abu Dhabi talks; stocks surge at midday while Nvidia lags; AST SpaceMobile's satellite venture with Rakuten in Japan; OpenAI hires Hacktron to probe its own systems, and a sobering coding-agent test; a cloud supply-chain attack through Qubole, a hijacked crypto developer tool, and Treasury's move against the MEXC exchange; your X feed; New Hampshire's first Black state senator-elect and the Lancers' strong finish; and glowworms back in Yorkshire. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Nov 9
item.description:

item.title: Monday Morning, Nov 9
item.description:
The Monday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 9, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; President Trump tells 60 Minutes his deportation policy was "too tough" as Stephen Miller starts as chief of staff, the Justice Department and Democrats square off over oversight, and the lame-duck Congress opens with a Hegseth impeachment push and a fight over Senate GOP leadership elections; Qatar's prime minister brings an Iran proposal to the White House, Russia and Ukraine trade heavy strikes before Abu Dhabi talks, the Krakow gunman dies in hospital, and a deadly steel-plant blast in western Turkey; a pre-market look at futures, Nvidia, yields, oil, gold, bitcoin and this week's inflation data; Tesla winds down the Cybertruck; Trump on A.I. guardrails and Anthropic's IPO roadshow; the Web3Auth wallet breach and an LNbits shutdown alert; your X feed; the Wild River Fire and tonight's council budget workshop; and dogs that sniff out invasive plants. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
